name: relevio
description: The relevio marketplace: session memory and handoff methodology for AI coding agents.

plugins.name: relevio
plugins.description: AI coding agents forget everything when their context window fills. relevio is session memory for them: context-usage awareness in real time, a written handoff before every close, and a navigable archive of never-compacted, reopenable sessions. Each session starts where the last one ended. For Claude Code and ZCode.
